title: Macro Clamp
prompt: Define `#define CLAMP(v, lo, hi)` as a do-while(0) statement macro that modifies v IN PLACE to lie within [lo, hi], and implement `int percent_band(int v)` returning 0 when v <= 0, 100 when v >= 100, and v otherwise.

tests.name: percent band
tests.hint: Compose CLAMP with the band logic.
